agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technological significance and bounded organizational implications

analytical_question: How much technological significance is justified, and how much weight should it carry in the current application decision?
general_et_finding: Abstain on all three labels for SparkSphere. C1-C4 unknown: the case supplies no identifiable mechanism, comparator, independent evidence or assessable pathway. Missing evidence cannot justify calling it incremental.
application_finding: No evidence connects this unidentified technology to the proposed brief or mockup.
organization_specific_finding: The same need for faster content production does not supply technology evidence.

evidence.claim: The case supplies only promotional assertions.
evidence.evidence_type: Test input, not evidence of technology performance
evidence.notes: No external technical evidence supplied; no capability claim verified.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Funding and slogans cannot establish mechanism, capability, breadth or societal significance.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that this packet is insufficient; no confidence rating for technology significance is warranted.
risk_governance_implication: Do not convert unsupported claims into adoption advocacy.
recommendation_management_implication: Request identifiable technology documentation and comparative evidence; defer any technology-based application judgment.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess after credible mechanism, comparator and original results are available.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Need a defined technology, baseline comparison, usable original evidence and an assessable societal pathway.
